fields.description: Montura brings four and five bedroom villas to Grand Polo Club & Resort. The community’s equestrian setting is reflected in its polo fields, clubhouse and stables, while the homes sit among landscaped routes and gardens. This is the original Montura collection; later numbered phases have their own plans and terms.

overview: Montura’s brochure puts the clubhouse and stables at the heart of the wider estate. Walking and cycling routes connect landscaped areas, with sports courts and smaller recreation spaces alongside them. Inside the homes, the brochure describes stone floors and detailed woodwork. These are design intentions: the chosen villa’s specification and the terms of access to equestrian facilities still need to be checked.
research.locationNote: Montura is within Grand Polo Club & Resort in Dubai. The developer’s map places the community in relation to The Oasis, Expo City and Al Maktoum International Airport. Its journey times are promotional estimates, not a guarantee; check the actual gate, road connection and daily route.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises Montura from AED 7.06 million. This is a published starting figure, not confirmation that a particular villa remains available. A current unit quotation is required.
research.paymentNote: The launch schedule has 10% on booking, seven subsequent 10% instalments and 20% at estimated completion. Some dates have passed; a buyer today must confirm the amount already due and the remaining contractual payments.
research.handoverNote: June 2029 is the estimated construction-completion month in Montura’s launch sheet and is also reported by Property Finder. Current construction progress and contractual handover require confirmation.

facts.label: Launch collection
facts.value: The fact sheet lists 211 villas: 183 with four bedrooms and 28 with five. These launch counts are not current stock availability.

facts.label: Historical prices and average plots
facts.value: Four bedroom villas launched from AED 7.06 million with a 5,184 sq ft average plot; five bedroom villas from AED 9.80 million with a 5,763 sq ft average plot. Individual plots vary.

facts.label: Area basis
facts.value: Four bedroom suites are 3,059.96–3,061.26 sq ft; five bedroom suites are 3,887.06–3,887.28 sq ft. Published totals additionally include balconies and carports, so they are not entirely enclosed living space.

facts.label: Layout differences
facts.value: The reviewed homes have ground, first and second levels with a maid’s room and a ground-floor guest bedroom. Four bedroom plans place a family room upstairs; five bedroom plans show a lift and an additional upper bedroom.
